title: SWAP 4.3.1 to SWAP5 functional closure registry
purpose: Account for every scientifically or functionally relevant SWAP 4.3.1 capability by current SWAP5 disposition without inferring status from branch names or historical migration documents.
closure_rule: Every identified legacy capability must end as CANONICALLY_ADMITTED, REPLACED_QUALIFIED, DELIBERATELY_RETIRED, or explicitly OPEN with one owner and dependency surface. Zero UNCLASSIFIED capabilities is required for functional closure.

governance.parallel_rule: parallel where ownership is disjoint; serial where semantics are shared
governance.branch_rule: Capability branches start from a pinned canonical commit. An active capability branch must never use another active capability branch as its parent.
governance.shared_change_rule: A required change to shared semantics becomes a separate prerequisite work unit and is admitted before dependent capability work consumes it.
governance.actions_rule: Use local builds and experiments during development. Use GitHub Actions only for persisted qualification, admission, preservation, or another gate that specifically requires remote evidence.
governance.registry_scope: This registry records status and routing only. It does not itself authorize physics or production implementation.
